{
  "version": 1,
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "id": "llamacpp-local",
      "label": "llama.cpp (this machine, managed)",
      "kind": "llamacpp",
      "base_url": "",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "",
      "enabled": true,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": "Keyless. Runs entirely on this computer: Alelyon starts llama.cpp's server when it is needed, with a GGUF model from ~/.alelyon/models."
    },
    {
      "id": "local-openai",
      "label": "Local server (vLLM / TGI / llama.cpp / LM Studio)",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "http://localhost:8000/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": "Point this at your own served weights. Keyless by default; set a key name if your server requires one."
    },
    {
      "id": "lmstudio",
      "label": "LM Studio (this machine)",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "http://localhost:1234/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": "LM Studio's local server, on its default port. Keyless. Leave the model blank and pick from what the server lists."
    },
    {
      "id": "llamacpp",
      "label": "llama.cpp server you run yourself (this machine)",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "http://localhost:8080/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": "A llama-server you started yourself, on its default port. Most builds serve one model and ignore the model field. The managed entry above needs no server of your own."
    },
    {
      "id": "anthropic",
      "label": "Anthropic",
      "kind": "anthropic",
      "base_url": "",
      "model": "claude-sonnet-5",
      "api_key_name": "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "huggingface",
      "label": "Hugging Face (Inference Providers)",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://router.huggingface.co/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "HF_TOKEN",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": "One token in front of the models hosted through Hugging Face's inference partners. Use a full model id such as openai/gpt-oss-120b; an optional :provider suffix pins which partner serves it."
    },
    {
      "id": "cohere",
      "label": "Cohere",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.cohere.ai/compatibility/v1",
      "model": "command-a-03-2025",
      "api_key_name": "COHERE_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "openai",
      "label": "OpenAI",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
      "model": "gpt-4o",
      "api_key_name": "OPENAI_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "google",
      "label": "Google Gemini",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai",
      "model": "gemini-2.0-flash",
      "api_key_name": "GEMINI_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "xai",
      "label": "xAI Grok",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.x.ai/v1",
      "model": "grok-2-latest",
      "api_key_name": "XAI_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "deepseek",
      "label": "DeepSeek",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.deepseek.com/v1",
      "model": "deepseek-chat",
      "api_key_name": "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "mistral",
      "label": "Mistral",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.mistral.ai/v1",
      "model": "mistral-large-latest",
      "api_key_name": "MISTRAL_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "groq",
      "label": "Groq",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1",
      "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
      "api_key_name": "GROQ_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "together",
      "label": "Together AI",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.together.xyz/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "TOGETHER_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "fireworks",
      "label": "Fireworks AI",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "FIREWORKS_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "openrouter",
      "label": "OpenRouter",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
      "model": "",
      "api_key_name": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY",
      "enabled": false,
      "builtin": true,
      "note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "my-vllm",
      "label": "Caf\u00e9 \u2713 \ud83d\ude00 \"q\"",
      "kind": "openai-compatible",
      "base_url": "https://example.invalid/v1",
      "model": "qwen3",
      "api_key_name": "MY_VLLM_KEY",
      "enabled": true,
      "builtin": false,
      "note": "tab\there"
    }
  ]
}
